environment: isolated local workerd; all outbound requests intercepted by local fixtures

checks.name: canonical HTTP 200 uses original shell and safe stable-ID metadata
alias one-hop HTTP 308 preserves subpage and safe query
canonical child page HTTP 200 keeps selected page
HEAD canonical and alias responses contain no body
root and static bypass registry; private headers and query stay local
unknown route retains original 404 with bounded lookups
POST fails closed without outbound calls
unconfirmed origin safely fails HTTP 503 without any outbound call

limitations: Cloudflare account Route/DNS forwarding is not simulated by Miniflare. Actual zone route and TLS/origin verification remain deployment preflight tasks.
